reportedIssues: The promo badge on the second 'Popular right now' card reads '-100%', implying a 100% discount (free order). This is almost certainly a data/formatting bug rather than a real offer.
The third card in 'Fastest near you' has its title truncated mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') and the image/price are clipped by the viewport edge with no ellipsis.
The second pizza card in 'Popular right now' is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar — its title, rating and delivery info are hidden behind/below the nav.
The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the first card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart.
The category chip row is clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip and no visual scroll affordance (fade or arrow), making it unclear more filters exist.
The notification bell's red dot indicator conveys unread state by color/shape only and has no visible label; icon-only nav and heart buttons also lack visible text alternatives.
The green promo banner's decorative circles are clipped awkwardly at the right/bottom corners, and the 'Order now' button sits close to the banner's bottom edge.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 directly describes a promo badge showing '-100%' on a card in 'Popular right now', matching the expected defect exactly.
